_note: Language registry for SPANDAN AI citizen intake. Support levels describe what works OFFLINE (no network, no API key) unless stated: SUPPORTED = implemented and tested end to end; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED = works offline for common civic complaints via the draft lexicon in backend/resources/intake/<code>.json (tested on demo sentences, limited vocabulary), or depends on the browser; FALLBACK = degrades safely (e.g. original text kept, English UI); UNAVAILABLE = not available. Add a language by adding an entry here, a resource file, and UI strings - no code change.

items.notes: Offline: pattern rules + lexicon (tested). Optional Gemini only fills facts the offline engine could not find. No translation needed.
